sec.title: Cyberattack on Austrian Foreign Ministry Exposes Diplomatic Staff Data
sec.brief: S. S. CISA adds Apache Axis, Vanderbilt REDCap,BerriAI LiteLLM, and Synology DSM flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog Norwegian Gas Giant Equinor Says It's Under Cyberattack. S. CISA adds Perforce Puppet Enterprise flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog Austrian Foreign Ministry confirmed a cyberattack against its website that exposed staff contact information, including details of employees working at diplomatic missions abroad. The security breach occurred between November 12 and 13, during a global Microsoft outage , and raises questions about the security of government websites and the risks associated with services managed by external providers. According to the ministry, attackers gained unauthorized access to a website operated by an external service provider. The intrusion was detected on November 13, and authorities said they stopped it immediately.
